_schema.purpose: Normative registry of the shared execution protocol. Declares rule ownership, scope, applicability, carrier mode, profile relation, holds, failure mode, lifecycle status, immutable provenance, and (for the grant) eligibility + fragment ownership. It does NOT record live consumer state — installed pin, present/absent/divergent, propagation status, or who is currently opted in. Those live in the operator control-surface_protocol-consumer-ledger.md.
per_rule_axes: scope_class            shared-core | coordinator | opt-in-grant | profile | candidate
applies_to             which repos should OBEY it (never implies write permission)
source_anchor          exact heading in AGENTS.shared.md (for machine coverage), or external carrier path
failure_mode           the failure this rule compensates for (R4 load-bearing test)
active_holds           hold-ids; a non-empty hold blocks graduation/retirement
status                 candidate | active | held | superseded | retired
proposed_by            candidate/held nomination label (e.g. a wave/round id); null once active

activated_by           immutable provenance where the rule became active. New contract: '#<PR> / <content-commit-SHA>' (the pre-merge commit that first carries the active body, NOT the eventual squash-merge SHA). Legacy forms: '<commit>[ (note)]' for scaffold rules, or 'legacy: <carrier>' where a first PR is untraced. null while candidate/held.
amended_by             ordered immutable amendment refs (PR#/SHA), or a wave/round label for a pre-landing revision
legacy_evidence        optional; oldest verified carrier/ref where a first PR is unavailable
per_consumer_axes_here: operating_surface_class (direct-core | separately-operated) — structural topology only. The live ledger axes (maintenance_authority_mode / carrier_state / hold_state / propagation_status) are OPERATOR-LEDGER state, NOT here.

LEGACY rows retain a squash-landing '#<PR> / <SHA>', a scaffold '<SHA> (note)', or a 'legacy: <carrier>' marker where the first PR is untraced.
